description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 mentioning the Duties & Functions of Ministry of Finance & Mass media w.e.f. 16.08.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the assignment of specific portfolios and responsibilities to named government ministers (the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Finance and Mass Media). It contains both the names of specific government positions AND detailed descriptions of the subject matter responsibilities being assigned (Development Lotteries Board, National Lotteries Board, and associated legislation). This meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government ministers) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities).
